title: Epidural Stimulation Mapping Protocol
author: Charles Hubscher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w6hfhb6
materials: Electrical stimulation equipment is connected to the Medtronic interface which controls the electrode implant. A grass stimulator (S88) with a current isolation unit provides the electrical stimulation.

steps.title: Place animal on platform
steps.instruction: After completing all surgical procedures, position the rat on the custom surgical platform and connect all required attachments.

steps.title: Secure animal posture
steps.instruction: Lay the rat on its ventrum, tape the hindlimbs to the platform, and hold the tail upright out of sight using a magnet‑anchored movable arm.

steps.title: Implant fine‑wire electrodes
steps.instruction: Using 27 g needles, bilaterally implant fine‑wire electrodes into the external anal sphincter (EAS) at an oblique angle from midline to lateral aspect, and into the bulbospongiosus (bulbo) muscle in males by palpating midway between scrotum and prepuce and inserting the needle transcutaneously.

steps.title: Insert pressure sensors
steps.instruction: Insert SPR‑524 pressure sensors (AD Instruments) into the rectum 2 cm from the anal verge and into the distal colon 10 cm from the anal verge; secure the probes to the base of the tail with tape and route their control unit to the data‑acquisition system.

steps.title: Set up perfusion pump
steps.instruction: Connect a perfusion pump to the catheter hub, set saline delivery to 0.25 ml min⁻¹, attach a pressure sensor to the pump syringe, and use a 60 ml syringe to provide enough saline for the entire testing session.

steps.title: Connect and amplify electrode wires
steps.instruction: Attach all electrode wires (ground, bilateral EUS, bilateral EAS, bilateral bulbo) to copper duck‑bill clip connectors, stripping only the minimal insulation needed for a secure clip; amplify the signals with an AM Systems 4‑channel differential amplifier and send them to the data‑acquisition unit.

substeps.instruction: Strip minimal insulation from each wire end.
Clip each stripped end onto a copper duck‑bill connector.
Connect the clipped wires to the AM Systems 4‑channel differential amplifier.
Route the amplified signals to the data‑acquisition unit.

steps.title: Place balance for void collection
steps.instruction: Position an Ohaus Scout balance beneath the surgical platform, connect it to the acquisition computer via an RS‑232 connector, and run the Serial Port Data Collect (SPDC) software to record voided material.

steps.title: Ground system components
steps.instruction: Ground the animal, perfusion pump, and surgical table to the electrophysiology cabinet that houses the stimulator and related electrical equipment.

steps.title: Configure data acquisition
steps.instruction: Ensure the CED 1401 micro 3 system is installed, open Spike2 version 8, and load the configuration file containing channels for EUS, EAS, bulbo, 2 cm probe, 10 cm probe, leaks, stim marker, and keyboard input.

steps.title: Start recording and bladder filling
steps.instruction: Begin recording in Spike2, then turn on the perfusion pump so bladder pressure rises as saline fills the bladder.

steps.title: Establish stable fill‑void cycles
steps.instruction: Allow the animal to undergo several fill‑void cycles until the interval between voids becomes consistent.

steps.title: Collect baseline measurements
steps.instruction: Record five baseline periods, each lasting 2 minutes, using a timer to ensure accurate timing.

steps.title: Perform stimulation trials
steps.instruction: After baseline, deliver epidural stimulation either for 2 minutes (if the fill‑void cycle is <2 minutes or shows a dripping pattern) or until a void occurs (if the cycle exceeds 2 minutes). Vary frequency (5, 10, 30, 45, 60 Hz) and intensity (50, 75, 100, 150, 300, 500 µA) in an increasing fashion, either changing frequency first or intensity first. Follow each stimulation with a 2‑minute off period.

substeps.instruction: Select the first parameter to vary (frequency or intensity).
Maintain stimulation for the defined duration (2 min or until void).
Turn off stimulation and wait 2 minutes before the next trial.

steps.title: Record experimental data
steps.instruction: During each trial, collect data on rectal and distal colon pressure, urethral sphincter (EUS) EMG, bulbo EMG (males), external anal sphincter (EAS) EMG, bladder pressure, urine expulsion via marker button, exact stimulation markers, voided urine volume, and any observer notes entered via keyboard.
